name: select machine
func:
var query = "SELECT M.machine_name FROM job J" +
            " inner join machine M on M.id = J.machine_id" +
            " order by J.id desc limit 1;"

msg.topic = String(query)

return msg;

name: set data

return msg;

name: select emp_name
func:
var query = "SELECT concat(E.fname, ' ', E.lname) as emp_name FROM job J" +
            " inner join employee E on E.id = J.employee_id" +
            " order by J.id desc limit 1;"

msg.topic = String(query)

return msg;

name: set data
func:
msg.payload = msg.payload[0].emp_name

return msg;
